title: CycloneDX Threat Model
$comment: OWASP CycloneDX is an Ecma International standard (ECMA-424) developed in collaboration between the OWASP Foundation and Ecma Technical Committee 54 (TC54). The standard is published under a royalty-free patent policy. This JSON schema is the reference implementation and is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

structural.description: Describes the primary architectural structure, layout constraints, and network topology.

primary.$comment: Values not listed can be proposed to the CycloneDX Property Taxonomy.
$todos: Update AI/ML property taxonomy with primary architecture enum values.
primary.description: The core mathematical structural framework of the model backbone.

meta:enum.transformer: Architecture based on self-attention mechanisms for processing sequential or spatial data.
meta:enum.cnn: Convolutional Neural Network - architecture using convolutional layers for processing grid-like data.
meta:enum.rnn: Recurrent Neural Network - architecture with recurrent connections for sequential data processing.
meta:enum.lstm: Long Short-Term Memory - RNN variant with gating mechanisms for long-term dependencies.
meta:enum.gru: Gated Recurrent Unit - RNN variant with simplified gating compared to LSTM.
meta:enum.gan: Generative Adversarial Network - dual-network framework containing a generator and a discriminator.
meta:enum.vae: Variational Autoencoder - probabilistic encoder-decoder architecture mapping to a latent space.
meta:enum.mamba: State-space model architecture with selective mechanisms for efficient sequence modeling.
meta:enum.ssm: State Space Model - core architecture based on continuous or discrete state-space representations.
meta:enum.gnn: Graph Neural Network - architecture optimized for processing graph-structured data elements.
meta:enum.mlp: Multi-Layer Perceptron - classic feedforward architecture composed entirely of fully connected layers.
meta:enum.rwkv: Receptive Weighted Key Value - architecture combining parallelizable training with RNN-like inference.
meta:enum.snn: Spiking Neural Network - neuromorphic architecture utilizing discrete, time-dependent spiking activations.
meta:enum.kan: Kolmogorov-Arnold Network - architecture featuring learnable activation functions on edges rather than nodes.

$todos: Update AI/ML property taxonomy with topologyType enum values.
topologyType.description: Specifies the runtime parameter activation and connection structure of the network layers.

meta:enum.dense: All or most parameters are active during inference with full connectivity between layers.
meta:enum.sparse: Only a subset of parameters are active during inference with selective connectivity.
meta:enum.dynamic: Parameter activation and connectivity patterns change based on input or runtime conditions.
meta:enum.liquid: Continuously adaptive network structure with time-varying connections and activations.

secondary.description: A list of secondary macro-layouts or component sub-networks built into the primary structure.

meta:enum.decoder-only: Autoregressive macro-layout processing data left-to-right (e.g., GPT series).
meta:enum.encoder-only: Bidirectional macro-layout processing complete sequences simultaneously (e.g., BERT).
meta:enum.encoder-decoder: Sequence-to-sequence structure mapping an input representation to an output sequence (e.g., T5).
meta:enum.mixture-of-experts: Sparse routing layer mechanism activating specific expert subnetworks per token.
meta:enum.vae-bottleneck: Symmetric compression bottleneck utilizing mean and variance latent vectors.
meta:enum.u-net: Symmetric contracting and expanding macro-layout featuring skip connections between corresponding scales.
meta:enum.residual-connections: Explicit skip or identity shortcuts bypassing one or more structural layers.
meta:enum.dual-encoders: Parallel feature extraction pipelines mapping different modalities into a shared space.
meta:enum.cross-attention-gated: Explicit sub-component routing that conditions one feature stream using another via attention mechanisms.
meta:enum.siamese-network: Twin identical subnetworks sharing identical weights to compute similarity metrics.
meta:enum.hybrid-backbone: Direct cascading combination of distinct primary layers (e.g., a CNN feature extractor feeding a Transformer).

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document properties in a name-value store. This provides flexibility to include data not officially supported in the standard without having to use additional namespaces or create extensions. Unlike key-value stores, properties support duplicate names, each potentially having different values. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of performance metric used for AI model evaluation.

meta:enum.mmlu-pro: Massive Multitask Language Understanding Pro - The current standard for broad, expert-level academic and professional reasoning across multiple disciplines.
meta:enum.gpqa: Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A - A highly difficult dataset used to test advanced, PhD-level reasoning and scientific problem-solving capabilities.
meta:enum.math-500: A subset of the MATH benchmark used to evaluate complex, multi-step mathematical reasoning and logic.
meta:enum.humaneval: The industry standard benchmark for evaluating Python code generation and functional programming synthesis.
meta:enum.swe-bench: Software Engineering Benchmark - Evaluates a model's agentic ability to resolve real-world software engineering issues and patches within complete, live code repositories.
meta:enum.ifeval: Instruction Following Evaluation - Tests a model's ability to strictly adhere to verifiable formatting constraints (e.g., specific word counts, starting sentences with specific words).
meta:enum.livebench: A frequently updated, contamination-free benchmark designed to test reasoning, math, and coding without the risk of models memorizing static test data.
meta:enum.webarena: An agentic benchmark evaluating a model's ability to perform complex, multi-step tasks using a web browser, APIs, and OS environments.
meta:enum.lmsys-elo: A crowd-sourced human preference rating derived from millions of blind A/B battle tests in the LMSYS Chatbot Arena.
meta:enum.strongreject: A standardized metric for measuring safety and alignment by evaluating how reliably a model refuses harmful prompts while avoiding false positives.

evaluationDatasets.description: References to the datasets or dataset subsets used to compute this performance metric.
